items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Joe Oltzalter; the name is introduced solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Fergie, yeah. That was Ferguson. And Charlie DeVoe. Yeah, and then they had the banjo player from Wisconsin.
Yeah. Joe Oltzalter and his Brady. And Kit Thomas. Yeah. He asked Kit Thomas a lot of questions.
And he knew Kit Thomas. Yeah, you know better than that, don't you?
